title: Chapter 419 Battle For The Great Wall
content:
Chapter 419 Battle For The Great Wall

Udon was already an intermediate blacksmith at this time, and there were also advanced blacksmiths in Shanhai City.

A Matar was no longer that important to the entire Dahuai Domain.

Wang Shuo immediately came to the ancient battlefield, adjusted the boss there to the level of a general, and then started fighting with him.

In the ancient battlefield, the highest level was only a junior general, which made Wang Shuo's battle a little unsatisfying.

He released the Ice Phoenix Emperor again as a sparring partner.

At the beginning, Wang Shuo saw that the Ice Phoenix Emperor was completely invincible. At this time, Wang Shuo was fully confident that he could defeat it.

Even in the heyday of the Ice Phoenix Emperor, he could still defeat it.

With the blessing of the Shura suit, Wang Shuo could already fight against the advanced generals.

But he still didn't find a way to stimulate his red pupil state, which made him a little irritable.

He couldn't fully exert his strength, which made him a little uncomfortable.

But the news of his subordinates' breakthroughs came, and his irritable heart was still calmed down a little.

Three months passed quickly.

During this period, Zhao Bangde had been trying to find Wang Shuo to compete, and Wang Shuo had no choice but to agree.

Zhao Bangde only had the strength of a mid-level general, and was completely different from the current Wang Shuo.

Even Wang Shuo's defense had to be broken with a big move.

Even if Zhao Bangde took out a killer move that he had never used before, it was still easily resolved by Wang Shuo.

This deeply stimulated Zhao Bangde.

In response, Zhao Bangde has been in seclusion for 1 month.

The affairs of the three counties are basically managed by Wang Shuo and Zhu Dongheng.

Zhu Dongheng also consciously took Wang Shuo as the main person. After all, his strength was there, and he put himself in a very correct position. He was a man of vision.

On this day, Zhao Bangde was still in seclusion, and Wang Shuo and Zhu Dongheng came to the Great Wall for inspection.

Wang Shuo used his hand to probe the strength of the barrier, and it was still unbreakable.

Once the barrier disappears, it is unknown what kind of enemy he will face.

And it will be directly integrated into the big family of the Shenwu Empire. At that time, the entire Dahuai Domain will be like a grain of sand, integrated into the desert.

A vast world will be fully displayed in front of the people of Dahuai Domain.

Wang Shuo was actually looking forward to it.

According to Dongfang Ling, people like his father are generally strong at the level of high-level generals, but there are only two or three in a city at most.

As for Shura generals, he has only heard of them, at least there are none in their area.

This gave Wang Shuo a lot of confidence.

Various weapons and supplies are fully capable of arming the army of Dahuai Domain.

At present, there are more than 2 million troops in the three counties.

Compared with the last battle, the strength has increased several times, mainly due to the resource exchange stone. The number of generals at all levels has increased exponentially. There are thousands of high-level generals alone, hundreds of top generals, and more than 20 generals.

If he can deal with the Black Dragon King with this strength, Wang Shuo believes that he can beat the Black Dragon King directly.

The war is coming, and Zhao Bangde has to come out.

Zhao Bangde has been holding back a lot of energy, wanting to break through the intermediate general, but he did not succeed.

Wang Shuo had to comfort him a few times, which made Zhao Bangde even more uncomfortable.

But Zhao Bangde was not a petty person, and he quickly adjusted his mentality and focused on the next battle.

Liu Hong personally came out on the other side of the barrier, dressed in military uniform, with four senior generals and 1 million armored soldiers in front of him.

Liu Hong's army was far more than this, but to guard against other enemies, he could only mobilize so many.

At the same time, he personally came out, which was considered to be extremely important to this operation.
